item.title: Boost heart health with Qunol CoQ10: Expert tips
item.description: Dr. Tiffany Di Pietro, cardiologist, recommends incorporating CoQ10 supplements, along with lifestyle habits like a balanced diet and regular exercise, to support heart health.

item.title: The best (and worst) states for women to scale a business
item.description: Women-owned businesses are expanding across the country, but the gains aren’t evenly shared. While women are launching companies at strong rates, revenue growth, workforce size, and overall performance vary depending on where those businesses are based.

item.title: A-MAX Insurance launches $25,000 giveaway
item.description: A-MAX Insurance is offering a community giveaway with a grand prize of $25,000 and six additional prizes of $1,000 each, in order to provide financial relief to families facing rising costs.

item.title: This ticket platform is giving away BLACKPINK Tokyo Dome tickets
item.description: AIR Shop enters global ticketing with a chance to score BLACKPINK Tokyo Dome seats.

item.title: Win vehicles and more in Monster Energy's giveaway
item.description: Monster Energy's "Summer of Monster Mayhem" promotion offers fans the chance to earn points by purchasing Monster Energy products, redeem them for tickets to various events, and enter a sweepstakes to win custom extreme vehicles and other prizes through Aug. 31.

item.title: Dallas Art Fair unveils $20K art prize for contemporary artists
item.description: John McAllister has been named the recipient of the 2026 Dallas ArtPrize, a $20,000 annual award recognizing artists for their cultural and intellectual contributions to contemporary art.

item.title: Jadewaters at Hilton Anatole unveils spring break package
item.description: JadeWaters at Hilton Anatole in Dallas will open its waterpark on February 27, offering a resort-style spring break option for families.

item.title: Trumpet players are given a chance in a rare giveaway
item.description: Yamaha is celebrating the 20th anniversary of its Xeno Artist Model Trumpets by holding a sweepstakes for a professional instrument valued at $7,675, open to the public and no purchase necessary, with entries accepted until March 31, 2026.

item.title: Uncover Larry Patzer's novels of loss and discovery
item.description: Larry Patzer discusses his novels The Palm Tree Coffee Shop Extraordinaire and The Past Always Comes Back, a story of loss and discovery, and hints at a possible third book in the series.

item.title: ChatGPT rivals Google as a leading source of quality info
item.description: Google remains the top choice for nearly half of Americans overall, but its lead is narrowing among frequent AI users, with ChatGPT now viewed as a comparable source of high-quality information.
